Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, August 19, 2019 1:36 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Cc: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Tigers today... 
 
Hey man, what’s up?
So, how we looking today. I figure we can stuff the spring training schedule inside something.
As for this afternoon, don’t forget, as we mentioned before, we gotta get Bregman talking about the possibility of being a Tiger a few seasons ago. The sooner we get that one pregame, the better.

And then for some point this week during this series, I think it’s a good time to start working on that “what if” scenario on if the Tigers did in fact trade for Bregman (probably more apropos than with Baez, right?) How would the dominoes have fallen from back then in that scenario. I think as far along that road you’d want to go, the better.
That’s all from me. Let me know what else you might have cooking this week.
By the way: I’m out after Wednesday until the middle of next week.
